title: Flat Lorentzian Lie groups: A complete description
summary: In this paper, we establish a complete structural description of flat Lorentzian Lie groups, i.e., Lie groups endowed with a flat left invariant Lorentzian metric, thereby resolving a long-standing open problem in the theory of pseudo-Riemannian Lie groups. Our main result shows that any flat Lorentzian Lie group either admits a timelike parallel left-invariant vector field or is of Kundt type, and that in both cases the underlying Lie algebra falls into one of six explicit classes.
